brief: Indian shares remain under pressure, with Sensex down over 1,100 points and Nifty below 25,500 as the global sell-off weighs, though Indian IT stocks such as TCS are gaining as investors rotate out of Nvidia-led tech. Europe is recovering from its steep tech sell-off, but hedge funds posted their worst week since April 2025.
